storageArea.title: Storage area
storageArea.description: Forces browser sync on (sync) or off (local). Accounts are always stored locally; no storage area is erased.

disableBackup.title: Disable backup
disableBackup.description: Hide the backup menu, backup reminders and backup page, and block reset (which requires a backup first). Automatic snapshots for damage recovery stay on.

enforcePassword.title: Enforce password
enforcePassword.description: Require users to set a password.

enforceAutolock.title: Enforce auto lock
enforceAutolock.description: Minutes of inactivity before the vault locks.

passwordPolicy.title: Password policy
passwordPolicy.description: Regular expression a password must match.

passwordPolicyHint.title: Password policy hint
passwordPolicyHint.description: Text shown when a password does not match the policy.
